answer: Each agent earns one identity bound to a nonce-chained work ledger: every completed task appends a hash of the prior record plus its output, so reputation is a single umber thread of verifiable work, and each link carries a pigment of unique attestation no forger can reproduce cheaply. A sybil can copy the ledger, but the next nonce must reference the chain tip, so forks cannot both extend it — like a zephyr splitting, only one branch stays canonical. Attacker cost: n clones require n times genuine compute and attestations, never near-zero.
